question: In Lucknow Session of Congress in 1916, both the Moderates and Extremist leaders were united. It was presided over by ________.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Ambika Charan Majumdar.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• Lucknow Session of Congress in 1916.
 
• President: Ambika Charan Majumdar.
 
• Famous for the Lucknow Pact and Unification of Moderates and Extremists.
 
• Since, the Surat Split, after about 10 years, both the Moderates and Extremists were united
 
• Also, Congress and the Muslim League signed the Lucknow Pact to build political consensus.
 
 
• It happened because, like Extremists, Muslim League also adopted the demand for self-government in its Lucknow session in 1913.<
